purpose: Labelled retrieval questions for IncidentLens. Each question has exactly ONE correct document in the corpus. The answer_anchor is a phrase that must appear in the correct document, so the label is verifiable.
version_note: Version 1 used the SAME words as the anchor phrase. BM25 then scored 1.000 on every metric, and no technique could show a gain. The measurement was blind, exactly like the old saturated corpus. Version 2 uses two kinds of question so the retrievers separate.
rules: One gold document for each question. No question has two answers.
The answer_anchor is a phrase from the gold document, verified before the question was written.
A question must not hold the answer_anchor word for word, unless its variant is declared 'literal'.
Every document must have at least one 'paraphrase' question. A paraphrase question is the hard case.

variants.literal: The question holds the exact term. BM25 has the advantage.
variants.paraphrase: The question uses different words. Dense retrieval has the advantage. This is the realistic case, because a real engineer does not know the wording of the report.

questions.question: Which Cloudflare service answers DNS queries and returned SERVFAIL responses on 4 October 2023?
Cloudflare customers received failure answers instead of addresses for websites they knew existed during an autumn 2023 resolver event. What broke?
What kind of Lua exception caused HTTP 500 errors for customers who had the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset deployed?
A small scripting fault in a rules engine returned server errors to a large group of web customers in December 2025. Which team published the explanation?
Which Cloudflare system produced an oversized feature file used by the Bot Management system?
A permissions change in a database made a file grow past a software limit, and that file then spread across a whole global network in November 2025. What is this incident?
Which automated Cloudflare cleanup task removed customer BYOIP prefixes by mistake?
Customers who advertise their own internet address blocks lost those routes in early 2026 because a tidy-up routine called an interface the wrong way. Which report covers this?
Which Cloudflare R2 service was disabled by mistake during an abuse remediation for a phishing report?
An operator meant to block one bad web address but blocked a whole product instead, with poor guard rails in the internal tool. Which incident is this?
Which command line parameter was omitted when the R2 team deployed new storage credentials to the wrong environment?
A team rotated secrets but sent them to a test system instead of the live one, so a gateway failed to authenticate. Which incident is this?
Which flaw in cookie validation logic made Cloudflare request handler processes enter an infinite loop?
A new denial-of-service defence exposed a latent fault, and request handlers burned all their processor capacity in a repeating cycle across many sites. Which incident is this?
Which Cloudflare deployment tool returned a staging build identifier to a production request?
Traffic was sent to an unauthorised address and answered with an authentication failure, because a release tool picked the wrong build version. Which incident is this?
Which React hook caused excessive API calls and took down the Cloudflare Tenant Service dashboard?
A user interface component called a backend far too often because of a mistake in its render inputs, and the load spread to other services. Which incident is this?
How many minutes were Cloudflare services unavailable on 24 January 2023 because of an error releasing service token code?
A mistake while shipping code that manages access credentials degraded a wide group of products for about two hours in early 2023. Which incident is this?
What did Meta blame for taking down its global backbone network on 4 October 2021?

Every service vanished for one company, and even the internal tools that staff use to fix problems stopped working, because a command disabled the network that connects its own centres. Which company reported this?
Which manifest bug restarted only the authoritative nameserver and made GitHub return NXDOMAIN for many records?
A configuration management fault restarted one of two name servers, and the repair attempt then built a broken zone from a service that itself needed naming to work. Which company reported this?
Which GitHub database endpoint became inaccessible after a configuration change broke routing-service health-check pings?
A change stopped machines from answering a monitoring probe, so the system marked them unfit and reading the site became impossible for over half an hour. Which company reported this?
Which loss cascaded and caused security policies to block access to critical VM metadata on GitHub?

A gap in measurement data made a system apply rules far too widely and cut off access to machine details, which stopped every virtual machine operation for almost six hours. Which company reported this?
What was the name of the user request that Postgres devoured, forcing Sentry down for most of a working day?
A counter inside a relational database reached its maximum value and the storage engine stopped accepting writes. Which company reported this?
What was the name of the unhandled condition in the async workers queue that crashed the incident.io application?
One bad message in a background job queue made a Go application crash again and again, and the hosting platform made the search for the cause harder. Which company reported this?
Which internal system failed at Datadog and caused a global infrastructure connectivity issue?
A bad entry in the registry that tells programs where to find each other spread everywhere when one client went down. Which company reported this?
Which cache nodes at Slack were removed and overloaded the vitness cluster?
Taking away memory servers pushed too much work onto a remaining cluster and the service went down. Which company reported this?
Which kernel driver file caused the CrowdStrike global outage and the memory bugcheck 0x00000050?
A security product shipped a bad content update that made computers worldwide show a blue screen and stop working. Which company reported this?
Which power equipment failed in a way that stopped backup generators from starting during an AWS EU West event?
A transformer fault and a controller that checks power phase prevented reserve power from arriving, and a cloud region lost many virtual machines. Which company reported this?
What caused the Cloudflare BGP route leak that involved a Verizon route and a BGP optimizer?
A routing mistake at one network spread through another and made a large part of the internet unreachable for a short period. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes a hardware failure on a primary database node that stopped cluster automation from promoting a replica?
A disk failed and the automatic promotion of a standby did not happen, so both a payment interface and its management screen stopped. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes network saturation in AWS traffic gateways that caused packet loss for a chat product?
Too much traffic through a cloud gateway dropped data on the wire, and an attempt to add capacity made matters worse. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes an AWS Kinesis disruption in the Northern Virginia region on 25 November 2020?
A stream processing service could not accept data because internal threads were exhausted, and the event rippled into other cloud services in one region. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes a MySQL replication topology that only listed a subset of servers after a failure?
A network split made two halves of a database believe each was in charge, and the tool that manages the cluster showed an incomplete picture. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes a Google Cloud VMware Engine resource that was deleted automatically at the end of a fixed term contract?
A private cloud was set up with an old option, and the automatic end of its rental period destroyed customer workloads sooner than expected. Which company reported this?
Which incident report describes an Azure storage service interruption that began in November 2014?
A configuration slip in one region made a cloud object store unavailable for many hours. Which company published the update?
Which incident report describes a Honeycomb total outage that stopped all data being processed?
An observability vendor went completely dark for just over an hour in July 2023. Which company reported this?
